name: Split Wave Login
description: Split-panel login card with a form on one side and an image on the other. Floating labels lift letter by letter in a wave when the field has text.
contents: Email and password fields with wavy floating labels
Forgot password link, sign in button, register link
Side image panel shown from tablet width up
behavior: Each label letter rises and shrinks with a staggered delay once the input has a value
Focused input underline and label take the accent color
Form submit is prevented, no data is sent
On screens below 768px the image panel is hidden and the card is a single column
editableByProps: All text, link targets and the side image
Accent, card and page background colors
Letter stagger speed of the label wave

needsCodeEdit.change: Wire the form to a real login handler

fixed: Root fills at least the viewport height and centers the card on the page background.
Uses a styled-jsx global style block for the input focus rules, which affects all inputs on the page.
